The drawing shows a phosphorus atom (P) with three substituents and a carbon neighbour:
- a double bond to O (P=O)
- two single-bonded OH groups
- a single bond to a carbon, which carries a C=O and an OH (a carboxylic acid)

This is phosphonoformic acid (foscarnet).

SMILES: OC(=O)P(=O)(O)O
